chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The sanctity of the anus is greater than the sanctity of the vagina. Indeed, Allah destroyed a community due to the sanctity of the anus, and He did not destroy anyone due to the sanctity of the vagina.'
ai.seo_question: Why is the sanctity of the anus considered greater than the vagina in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the superior sanctity of the anus compared to the vagina, linking this distinction to the divine destruction of the people of Lot. This hadith highlights that while vaginal intercourse outside marriage is a major sin, the specific devastation of the Lot community was uniquely attributed to their transgression of anal sodomy, underscoring its unique severity in Shia jurisprudence.
